technology_name: Fresh Ginger Value Addition and Dry Powder Production Technology
institution: CSIR-National Institute for Interdisciplinary Science and Technology (NIIST)
problem_solved: Need for removal of adhering mud and enhancement of shelf life for fresh ginger.
description: A continuous or batch-wise process for washing, cleaning, waxing, grading, and drying fresh ginger. The operations involve mechanical dewatering, sorting by size, powdering for smaller ginger, and optional waxing of larger ginger to produce a superior grade market product.
applications: Continuous cleaning and post-harvest washing of raw ginger , Industrial processing of premium dry ginger powders , Automated grading and surface waxing of export-grade ginger , Dehydration and mechanical dewatering of root spice crops
secondary_sector: Agribusiness & Rural Economy, Consumer & Lifestyle Products
